stories.title: Hormuz talks positive, Oman says, as Iran warns deal would not open strait
stories.body: Both sides suggest progress in talks to agree a new shipping route through the strait, but a breakthrough remains unclear.

stories.title: Trump's ex-lawyer Todd Blanche narrowly confirmed as US attorney general
stories.body: The vote cements Trump's former criminal defence lawyer as the nation's top law enforcement official despite a rare pushback from some Republicans.

stories.title: US offers $1bn to Colombia on new right-wing president's first day of office
stories.body: Abelardo de la Espriella used his maiden speech to promise an "all-out war" on what he calls "narco-terrorism".

stories.title: Messi's father Jorge dies aged 68 after illness
stories.body: Lionel Messi's father and agent Jorge dies at the age of 68 following a long illness.

stories.title: Madonna pays tribute to 'genius, otherworldly' producer William Orbit
stories.body: The Queen of Pop worked with Orbit several times over the years, most notably on her genre-bending, Grammy Award-winning album Ray of Light.

stories.title: Watch: Moment opposition MP throws eggs at Kosovo's acting PM
stories.body: Lawmakers and police officers had to intervene after Alliance party MP Time Kadrijaj hurled at least four eggs towards Kosovo's acting prime minister Albin Kurti.

stories.title: Paris tells e-scooter riders to wear safety gear or face fines
stories.body: Police in the French capital tighten rules for riders after a sharp increase in fatal accidents.

stories.title: Spain imposes border controls against Italy as row over Ceuta migrant influx intensifies
stories.body: Italy introduced border controls following an influx of about 78,000 migrants from Morocco into the neighbouring Spanish exclave of Ceuta.

stories.title: Child among three killed in Russian missile attacks near Kyiv
stories.body: Russia continued its overnight attacks after President Volodymyr Zelensky warned of Ukraine's dwindling supplies of missile interceptors.

stories.title: Typhoon Dolphin batters Japan's Okinawa before bearing down on China
stories.body: The storm has cut power to at least 44,000 buildings and injured five people on the Japanese island.

stories.title: Fast-moving Canada wildfire doubles in size forcing thousands to flee homes
stories.body: The Bald Range wildfire in British Columbia, still considered "out of control", has spread to more than 36 sq miles (95 sq km).

stories.title: Thai PM vows to introduce stricter gun laws after eight killed in shooting
stories.body: Eight people were killed when a 14-year-old opened fire at his home and school before shooting himself dead.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
stories.body: Pakistan says an attack on any of the three will amount to an attack against all, amid conflict in the Middle East.

stories.title: Spanish police arrest 78 people in bust of 'one of largest' smuggling networks
stories.body: The group moved synthetic drugs from Spain to Algeria, then used the return journey to smuggle migrants and weapons.

stories.title: NBA forward Clarke's death due to effects of drugs
stories.body: Memphis Grizzlies forward Brandon Clarke's death was due to the effects of heroin and cocaine, the Los Angeles medical authority reveals.

stories.title: Hunter Biden tells BBC his pardon was 'not good' for US or his father's legacy
stories.body: In a wide-ranging BBC interview, the former president's son denies any interest in running for office and says his father's cancer has spread.

stories.title: Book hidden in fireplace returned to Australian library 150 years overdue
stories.body: It is thought an apprentice stonemason who worked on the Houses of Parliament in London borrowed it.

stories.title: Kidnapped rare Serbian eagle freed into wild after rescue
stories.body: Feliks the eagle was abducted as he first flew the nest in Serbia and wound up in the Middle East with poachers who demanded a ransom.

stories.title: Australia is the planet's extinction hotspot, but one animal offers a glimmer of hope
stories.body: The country is home to some of the world's most unique species - but it is losing them at an alarming rate.

stories.title: The phone book that led us to Assad's spy chief in hiding
stories.body: How we tracked down "The Spider" who was once one of the most-feared men in Syria.
